approval.decision: The user approved the refined move-handle prototype and requested a handoff for another agent to integrate it and continue #36. This follows selection of the move handle and agreement to the icon, fixed on-screen handle size, immediate provisional panel movement and settled release.
approval.reason: Make the drag target explicit while preserving single-click child selection and direct visual feedback.
behaviour: Four-direction move icon and Move frame label form one draggable handle, with grab/grabbing cursors.
The handle stays 30 CSS pixels tall at the tested zoom levels and remains reachable at canvas bounds.
Visible panel and child hit targets follow provisional movement immediately. Release retains position and keyboard focus while rendering confirmation is pending.
Single-click child selection, Escape cancellation, keyboard adjustments and one Undo entry per completed drag remain available.
deviations: This approves the manipulation design, not the isolated sample editor layout or a replacement for flow-v1.
HTML content and delayed confirmation are simulated. Production must preserve Ren'Py fidelity, validated source transactions and native qualification.
The sample uses fixed-corner resizing and bounded sample sizes. Production retains its existing alignment/anchor semantics.
Zoom and delay controls support prototype review; the simulated delay control does not belong in production.
Light theme and unrecorded viewport/gesture conditions are outside the retained visual comparison captures.
